name: TradeCraft
description: Multi-agent hex-map resource trading game for autonomous OpenClaw agents.

socketPath.description: Unix socket path for the TradeCraft game engine.

playerIds.description: Player ids (0-3) whose engine connections this gateway opens eagerly at startup. In single-gateway mode all players are served by one gateway, so list every seat here.

playerId.description: Static player identity (0-3) for single-agent setups. Prefer playerIds; per-call player identity is otherwise resolved from the agent/session runtime context. Defaults to TRADECRAFT_PLAYER_ID env var.

language.description: Language for agent-facing tool labels/descriptions (UN languages). Protocol values stay English.

socketPath.label: Socket Path
socketPath.help: Unix socket path for the TradeCraft game engine daemon.

playerIds.label: Player IDs
playerIds.help: Player ids served by this gateway (0-3); their engine connections open at startup.

playerId.label: Player ID
playerId.help: Static player identity for single-agent setups (0-3).
